notes_for_editor: Almost all history and design detail rests on the NHLR detail page; the FFLA indexes add only standing status and register number. No staffing, access, visit or fire sources were found: hikearizona.com (trail page on Signal Peak) returned 403 to both fetch_text and WebFetch, and no Wikipedia article exists for this lookout. Facts omit access and staffing because no source supports them; NHLR's 'active station' wording is not read as staffed. height_m converts NHLR's 59 ft. The FFLA index coordinates (33.29317, -110.83597) differ from NHLR's (33.29312, -110.83595) by under 10 m; no correction proposed. A search hit for a Washington Signal Peak lookout (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/wa/) is a different tower and was not used. No photos added. Peakbagging's Arizona table (revised 2024-10-02) codes the structure A, meaning good condition and capable of being staffed; that is a building condition, not a staffing record.
